name: Koch / Dragon Fractal
desc: A thick spectral fractal curve that morphs between Koch snowflake, Levy C and Heighway dragon families, filled as a faint luminous body and stroked with a glowing hue-along-length line that slowly rotates and breathes.

depth.doc: recursion depth (fractal detail; clamped to seg budget)

density.doc: line + halo weight and bloom breadth

seed.doc: deterministic variation (family jitter, phase, hue offset)
